purpose: The one fixed narration every subtitle pipeline run is measured on. Numbers are SPELLED OUT so the synthesiser reads them right; the formatter must turn them into digits (standing rule).
how_to_verify: 1) synthesise `audio` with the voices below; 2) open it in Audacity; 3) for each entry in verified_words, set `t` to the word's onset in seconds (3 decimals); 4) set verified = true. The five timing columns stay `untested — key unverified` until then.

voices.NARRATOR: the house documentary narrator voice (Narration Audio Stack default), English
voices.ANNA: the Anna voice used on the ledger intro, Dutch

audio.assembly: concatenate the segments in order with the silences given; insert bell.wav at [bell] and dog_bark.wav at [dog barks] from the SFX library slates; loudnorm -16 LUFS after a limiter (scene audio levels rule)

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: In sixteen seventy-one, the yard at Kattenburg launched a pinas they called the Zeehond.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Nicolaes Witsen wrote it all down, from the first keel plank to the last twenty-three barrels of tar.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Cornelis, the master shipwright, kept a book of his own, and his apprentice Joost kept the key to it.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The launch was set for the morning tide, when the water at the gauge stood highest and the wind, which had blown from the north-east for eleven days without pause and had kept every ship in the harbour idle at its moorings, finally turned to the south-west and let the yard breathe again.
segments.note: the planted long sentence: forces three or more cues and tests breaks on sense

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: I— I mean, the second tide. The first one came too early.
segments.note: the planted false start: verbatim must keep it

segments.speaker: CORNELIS
segments.text: Drieëntwintig tonnen teer, Joost. Niet tweeëntwintig. Tel ze nog eens.

segments.speaker: ANNA
segments.text: Hij heeft ze drie keer geteld, Cornelis. Het zijn er drieëntwintig.
segments.note: two speakers back to back: the speaker probe

segments.speaker: CORNELIS
segments.text: Dan is er één te veel op het schip.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: By noon the Zeehond was in the water, and Witsen's drawing of her hull was already on its way to the printer.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Twenty-three barrels went with her. One of them, Cornelis always said, was never paid for.

transcript_verbatim: the concatenation of segments 1-12 text fields, SFX segments excluded, in order — the WER reference

video.command: ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i "color=c=0x203040:s=1280x720:r=25:d=DUR" -i narration.wav -filter_complex "[0:v]drawtext=text='%{pts\:hms}':fontsize=48:fontcolor=white:x=40:y=40, drawbox=enable='between(t,10,25.5)+between(t,41,63)+between(t,88,120)+gte(t,150)':x=0:y=0:w=1280:h=720:color=0x604020@1.0:t=fill[v]" -map "[v]" -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -shortest cutlist.mp4
video.note: DUR = the audio length; the drawbox toggles the background colour at every cut so the cut list is visible to the eye and to a shot-change detector

burn.filter: the house subtitles filter in pipeline_video._burn_subtitles (fontsize, margin, box) — unchanged
burn.ocr: typography OCR judge on a 1280x720 frame at each sampled cue midpoint
